packageRules.description: Base image updates are shipping updates, so they ship as patch releases; see https://github.com/andrewheberle/renovate-config/blob/main/docs/adr/0001-shipping-updates-are-fix-commits.md
Go toolchain updates are shipping updates, like base image updates; see https://github.com/andrewheberle/renovate-config/blob/main/docs/adr/0001-shipping-updates-are-fix-commits.md
Go toolchain patch updates carry security fixes, so they automerge once build passes; see https://github.com/andrewheberle/renovate-config/blob/main/docs/adr/0001-shipping-updates-are-fix-commits.md

Shared preset bumps are not shipping updates; minor and patch bumps automerge, major bumps wait for a person; see https://github.com/andrewheberle/renovate-config/blob/main/docs/adr/0002-consumed-by-tag-released-by-release-please.md
